remarks: Renovated 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom expanded Cape in Springdale, Stamford, Connecticut. This 1,944-square-foot home features an open floor plan with a fully updated kitchen, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and tile flooring. A dining area with a detailed architectural ceiling connects to the main living space, offering seamless flow for everyday living and entertaining. The primary bedroom includes a vaulted ceiling, creating an airy, spacious retreat. Both full bathrooms have been updated with modern finishes. A dedicated bonus room on the main level provides flexible space - ideal as a home office, gym, or studio. The rear of the home opens directly to a deck and patio - a true flat entertaining space. This home sits near the Springdale Metro-North train station, offering a quick commute to Grand Central. Near local shops and restaurants, with easy access to the Merritt Parkway and I-95. A move-in-ready, updated home with flexible space and a commuter-friendly location.
